label: manifold
definition: A smooth n-dimensional manifold M is a second-countable Hausdorff topological space equipped with a maximal smooth atlas of charts.

label: tangent space
definition: The tangent space T_p M at a point p in M is the vector space of all tangent vectors (derivations) at p.

label: riemannian metric
definition: A Riemannian metric g on M is a smooth assignment of a positive-definite inner product g_p on each tangent space T_p M.

label: levi civita
definition: The Levi-Civita connection \nabla is the unique torsion-free, metric-compatible affine connection on the Riemannian manifold (M,g).

label: partition of unity
definition: Given any open cover of M, there exists a smooth partition of unity subordinate to it.

label: covariant derivative
definition: The covariant derivative \nabla_X Y is tensorial (linear over C^\infty(M)) in X and satisfies the Leibniz rule in Y.

label: riemann curvature
definition: The Riemann curvature tensor R measures the failure of iterated second covariant derivatives to commute; it is a (1,3)-tensor.

label: gauss bonnet
definition: For a closed orientable surface M, the integral of Gaussian curvature K over M equals 2\pi times its Euler characteristic \chi(M).

label: manifold
definition: M denotes a smooth manifold in differential geometry.

label: tangent space
definition: T_p M denotes the tangent space at point p of manifold M.

label: metric tensor
definition: g denotes the Riemannian metric tensor on a manifold.

label: levi civita connection
definition: Nabla denotes the Levi-Civita connection or covariant derivative operator.

label: riemann curvature tensor
definition: R denotes the Riemann curvature tensor measuring non-commutativity of covariant derivatives.

label: fundamental theorem of calculus
definition: The fundamental theorem of calculus links differentiation and integration of continuous functions.

label: differentiation under the integral sign
definition: Differentiation under the integral sign exchanges derivative and integral operators.

label: increment equals integral of derivative
definition: The increment of a function equals the integral of its derivative over an interval.

label: definition of euler number e
definition: Euler's number e is defined as the limit of (1 + 1/n)^n as n tends to infinity.

label: newton's second law
definition: Force equals mass times acceleration: F = m a.

label: work
definition: Work is force times displacement: W = F d.

label: law of gravitation
definition: Newton's law of gravitation: F = G m1 m2 / r^2.
